newsitem.title: USA: Pointcast, News Corp deal stuck on price - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Pointcast, News Corp deal stuck on price - NYT.

text.p: News Corp has been negotiating to buy privately held Internet broadcaster Pointcast, but the two sides were far apart on a price, the New York Times said on Wednesday.
News Corp has offered to pay about $400 million, but Pointcast executives want much more, the newspaper said, citing a source close to the situation.

Pointcast, which is contemplating an initial public offering, said in a statement on Tuesday it intended to remain independent. Pointcast Chief Executive Christopher Hassett also denied recent market speculation, telling Reuters on Monday: "That's a rumor. There are no facts behind that."
News Corp declined to comment on the report.
The source close to the situation estimated there was a 50 percent chance a deal would go through, the newspaper said.
